Mission Local reported that a male after-school worker at Everett Middle School was arrested by San Francisco police over alleged inappropriate contact with a student. The school district said the school reported the incident to police, and both police and SFUSD were investigating. The story said it was unclear whether the man was an employee or volunteer of Mission Graduates.

Story: “Everett after-school worker arrested over alleged improper contact with student,” published March 7, 2024.

Correction: A previous version said parents reported receiving no communication immediately after the incident; the story was updated to note that the principal had sent an email soon after.
